description: Screenshot of Q drop #1871 (tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, dated 14 Aug 2018), titled 'MSM Command Structure' in an aggregator's dark-theme layout. The post presents an ASCII diagram claiming a command hierarchy flowing from '(MOS)' (Q shorthand for Mossad, highlighted in red) down to '(Alt + US Media)' and '(US Politicians)', followed by lines suggesting mainstream media affiliates march in coordination. The hierarchy claim is the drop's own assertion.
text: MSM Command Structure. 1871. Q !!mG7VJxZNCI 14 Aug 2018 - 5:46:46 PM. Ex 1.1. (MOS). / \. (Alt + US Media) (US Politicians). / \. (......................)(........................). Those who scream the loudest.... Find the connections. 1:1:1:1. Primary>>AffiliateA>>AffiliateB>>AffiliateC>>. Marching to the same beat? Coincidence? Logical thinking. Q
flags: Drop claims Mossad directs US media and politicians — unverified claim of the post itself

description: News-agency photograph of the USS Arizona Memorial at Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, seen from the water. A large American flag flies in the foreground, backlit against dramatic clouds, with the white memorial structure spanning the sunken battleship behind it and a second US flag on the memorial's flagpole. An AFP/Getty Images watermark runs along the right edge; the filename ('pearl-harbor-2.jpg') matches the location.

'Spygate' meme. The top half is a dark blue-tinted photo collage of five Obama-era officials — John Brennan, James Clapper, Barack Obama (center), Andrew McCabe, and James Comey — under the headline 'SPYGATE!'. The bottom half carries a caption claiming Obama is the first ex-president to collude to impede his successor, an assertion the meme makes without evidence.
text: SPYGATE!. Never has a president left office to collude with others to impede the next sitting president of the United States of America until Obama!
orgs: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
flags: Meme's collusion claim against Obama and the pictured officials is an unverified political assertion

description: Screenshot of a June 18, 2017 Facebook post from Rep. Adam Schiff's 'Congressman Adam Schiff' page: a Father's Day family photo of Schiff with his father, his brother, and his son. The teenage boy wears a black novelty t-shirt reading 'MOSSAD SINCE 1949', which is the detail the sharer evidently highlights; two visible comments include one praising the shirt. Engagement shows 3.3K reactions, 211 comments, 33 shares.

flags: Schiff's father, brother, and minor son are private individuals and are left unnamed; the boy is a minor
Commenter names appear only as transcribed text, not identifications
The 'MOSSAD SINCE 1949' shirt is a novelty tee; any implied Mossad connection is an insinuation by those sharing the image
